evals.prompt: Create a NotebookLM notebook about Hebrew NER tools, add these three URLs as sources, then query it for a comparison: https://huggingface.co/dicta-il/dictabert-ner, https://github.com/NLPH/NLPH_Resources, https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.04321
evals.expected_output: Agent should: (1) call notebook_create with descriptive title, (2) call source_add with source_type='url' for each URL or bulk urls=[], using wait=True, (3) call notebook_query with a comparison question. Should NOT try to use browser tools or navigate URLs manually.

assertions.description: Creates notebook with descriptive title containing 'Hebrew' or 'NER'
assertions.check: notebook_create called with title containing topic

assertions.description: Adds all 3 URLs as sources using source_add, not browser navigation
assertions.check: source_add called with source_type='url' for each URL

assertions.description: Uses wait=True on source_add to ensure indexing before query
Queries notebook with a substantive comparison question

evals.prompt: I have a bunch of research PDFs about knowledge graphs in ~/Downloads/kg-papers/. Create a NotebookLM notebook, upload them, run deep research on 'local-first knowledge graph architectures for AI agents', and generate a briefing doc report I can read.
evals.expected_output: Agent should: (1) list PDFs in the directory, (2) create notebook, (3) add PDFs via source_add with source_type='file', (4) run research_start with mode='deep', (5) poll research_status, (6) research_import, (7) studio_create with artifact_type='report' and report_format='Briefing Doc', (8) poll studio_status, (9) download_artifact

assertions.description: Adds local PDFs using source_type='file', not text or url
Downloads the report to a local file

evals.prompt: Generate an audio podcast overview of my existing NotebookLM notebook about Huberman protocols. The notebook already exists. Make it a debate format, short length. Download to ~/Desktop/huberman-debate.mp3
evals.expected_output: Agent should: (1) list notebooks to find the Huberman one, (2) call studio_create with artifact_type='audio', audio_format='debate', audio_length='short', confirm=True, (3) poll studio_status until complete, (4) download_artifact to the specified path. Should NOT create a new notebook or add sources.

assertions.description: Lists notebooks to find existing Huberman notebook
Does NOT create a new notebook (reuses existing)
Creates audio with debate format and short length
Asks for confirmation before studio_create (confirm=True involves user approval)
assertions.check: Agent asks user before passing confirm=True

assertions.description: Downloads to the exact path specified by user
